title: fix(app-shell): editing an action in Studio no longer stops the object from saving
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbQRVsC49uBbvJrjUXbWLaCA)_

Fixes #26728
Fixes #26736

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio 的动作编辑器(数据 › 对象 › 操作)三处修正:「开放给 AI 智能体」改写规范的嵌套 `ai` 块;切换「类型」时清掉新类型拒收的键(如 API 动作上的脚本 `body`);「请求体形态」改成「平铺 / 包裹(键)」控件。数据支柱对「只是还没填完」的动作暂存不发送并说明缺什么,对服务端拒收的保存在提示条里点名到具体动作,「定位」直接打开它。
- **为什么改**:这三处以前都会写出规范拒收的动作,之后对象的每次自动保存都被 422 拒绝,直到刷新页面,界面上也看不出是哪个动作出了问题。
- **风险与回滚**:低。不改规范、不新增元数据键、不碰服务端;只改设计器的写法、暂存判断与两种语言的文案。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` 的 `patchAi` / `commitType` / `TYPE_SCOPED_KEYS`;`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/metadataError.ts` 的 `actionHeldInput`(暂存判断,以规范的 `ActionSchema` 为准);`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的 `showObjTarget`。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.actionRefusal-26736.test.tsx`,预期 2 个用例全绿;或在 Studio 里勾选「开放给 AI 智能体」再取消,对象照常保存,不再出现 422。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Three controls in Studio's action inspector wrote an action `@objectstack/spec` refuses, and the Data pillar then sent it, so every later save of the object answered 422 until a reload:

| control | wrote | now writes |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Expose to AI agents, and its description | flat `aiExposed` / `aiDescription` (refused by name) | the spec's `ai: { exposed, description }`, merged into any `ai` block the draft holds; the next write clears the flat keys an older draft carries; unticking drops a description the spec would refuse as too short (its box hides while unexposed) |
| Type | only `type`, keeping `body`, `onSuccess`, `outcomeMessages`, `undoable: true` the new type refuses | `type`, plus `undefined` for each of those keys the draft holds and the new type refuses (`TYPE_SCOPED_KEYS`); everything the new type accepts, `target` included, is kept |
| Body Shape | free text under "More fields" (`{"wrap":"payload"}` became a string; a stored `{ wrap }` displayed as `payload`) | a curated Flat / Wrap control with a key input: `'flat'`, or `{ wrap: KEY }` once a key is typed (an empty key is never written; the spec would accept it and nest under `""`) |

The refusal surface the inspector reports through (`studio-design/metadataError.ts`, the Data pillar in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, and `ObjectActionsPanel.tsx`):

- **Held, not refused.** `objectHeldEdit` now also asks `actionHeldInput` of each action: the spec's `ActionSchema` judges the action, and when every issue is an input the inspector offers that has no value yet (a script source, a script's body when it has neither body nor target, the `target` a type requires, an exposed action's AI description absent or still too short) the object is held unsent, with the neutral line "Not saved yet: API endpoint on the action “Send” needs a value". Anything else is sent and its refusal shown.
- **A refusal is placed on the action.** `objectSaveRefusal` gains `objectActionLocator`: an issue at `actions.INDEX…` names the action by its label, and the input when the key under it is one the inspector edits. "Show me" switches to the Actions view and selects that action (`ObjectActionsPanel`'s new `focus` prop), from any view.
- **Recovery needs no reload.** The autosave already resends on the next edit; with the writes above, that edit leaves a draft the spec accepts, and the strip clears when the save lands.

`ActionPreview` read the flat `aiExposed` for its AI pill; it now reads `ai.exposed`, since the inspector no longer writes the flat key (bounded in-place fix, on the claim's amended surface). New `studio` namespace strings, en and zh: the Body Shape control, `engine.studio.refusal.action` / `actionInput`, `engine.studio.held.actionNeedsInput`. No `packages/spec/**`, server or new metadata key.

## Why

One visible checkbox, or an ordinary Type switch, stopped the whole object from saving, with nothing on screen saying which action or why; a reload discarded the edits. The spec already defines every shape written here, so the defect was the designer's.

## Tests

- `ActionDefaultInspector.aiBlock-26728.test.tsx` (ask 1): the real inspector, drafts parsed with `ActionSchema` after a JSON round trip. A tick writes `{ ai: { exposed: true } }` and the only refusal is `ai.description`; a 40-character description parses and reads back; unticking parses with and without a description; a draft carrying the flat keys parses after the control's next write; other `ai` keys are kept; `AI_DESCRIPTION_MIN` is the spec's minimum both sides.
- `ActionDefaultInspector.typeSwitch-26736.test.tsx` (asks 2, 3): script with a body → API drops the body, and the draft parses once the endpoint is typed (and after a Method edit); every type-scoped key is cleared, `undoable: false` kept; a switch with nothing to clear writes the type alone and keeps `target`. Body Shape: a stored `{ wrap: 'payload' }` reads back as Wrap / `payload`; Wrap writes nothing until a key, then `{ wrap: KEY }`; clearing the key takes the shape off; Flat writes `'flat'`; the old JSON text is refused `invalid_union`. Parity: each `TYPE_SCOPED_KEYS` entry parsed on every `ActionType`, refused exactly off its listed types.
- `metadataError.actionHeld-26736.test.ts` (asks 2, 4): seven held cases, each paired with the spec's own refusal; four finished-but-wrong cases not held; the object-level hold names the action and selects it; field holds still come first; refusals at `actions.N.body` and `actions.N` are placed on the action; field paths unchanged; an unplaceable path stays unlocated.
- `DataPillar.actionRefusal-26736.test.tsx` (asks 1, 2, 4): the real Data pillar, real inspector, real `MetadataClient`, a transport that parses each action with `ActionSchema` and answers 422 with `actions.N…` issues. A refused save names the action; "Show me" from the Form view opens it on Actions; tick + untick sends an accepted save and the strip clears, no reload. Script → API is held (no PUT, held line names the endpoint on the action), and typing it sends an accepted save.
- Moved fixtures: `automationPreviews.i18n-10862.test.tsx` and `inspectorStrings.hookAction.i18n-10586.test.tsx` now carry `ai: { exposed }` instead of the flat keys.
- Ablations (one-off, not kept), each through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on committed head `27b93089`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty: A1 `patchAi` writes `aiExposed` → aiBlock 4 failed; A2 Type switch clears nothing → typeSwitch 2 failed + DataPillar held case failed; A3 no action hold → metadataError 1 + DataPillar 1 failed; A4 no action locator → metadataError 2 + DataPillar refusal case failed. Control after restore: Tests 36 passed (36).

## Acceptance notes

- `ai` stays editable under "More fields" (not curated), so `category`, `paramHints`, `outputSchema` and `requiresConfirmation` remain reachable; `exposed` and `description` are therefore editable in both places, writing one block.
- A Type switch keeps `target`. Moving between two target types (a URL to a flow) keeps the old value in the new type's picker, where an unknown name shows as `(not found)`; the spec judges it on the new type.
- The hold's notion of "unfinished" is the spec's own refusal at those inputs, so a whitespace-only script source, which the spec accepts, is sent.
- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` edit is about 20 lines in the Data pillar; #26737 edits the same file's flow fold, so whichever lands second merges `main`.

## Verification

All readings at head `27b93089` (base `c8583f80`), under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` where heavy.

<details><summary>Touched packages: @object-ui/app-shell, @object-ui/i18n</summary>

- Prerequisite builds: `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/sdui-parser --filter=@objectstack/lint --filter=@objectstack/client --concurrency=2`, 36 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Type-check: `cd ui && pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n --concurrency=2`, 65 tasks; both packages run `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` (the test config covers the new tests); VERDICT command-exit 0.
- The four new test files plus every `ActionDefaultInspector*`, `metadataError*`, `DataPillar*`, `ObjectActionsPanel*` file and the two moved fixtures: Test Files 41 passed (41), Tests 322 passed (322). The rest of app-shell is left to CI's Test UI shards.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (reads the i18n catalogues): Test Files 178 passed, 2 skipped (180); Tests 5065 passed, 2 skipped; VERDICT command-exit 0.
</details>
